condition.narrative: Ethiopia financing agreement: No later than one month from the Effective Date, MoA and MoTRI shall enter into a Memorandum ofUnderstanding which shall be maintained throughout implementation of the Project, for purposes of setting out the implementationroles and responsibilities of MoA and MoTRI under the Project.

Ethiopia financing agreement: Within six months from the Effective Date, the Recipient shall hire an accountant for the PCU in MoA,under terms of reference and with qualifications and experience acceptable to the Association

Ethiopia, Djibouti, Kenya, Somalia financing agreements: The Recipient shall establish a Project Steering Committee and a ProjectTechnical Committee with mandate, composition and resources satisfactory to the Association within 3 months of the effective date.

ZEP-RE grant agreement and project agreement: Within three months from the Effective Date, the Recipient shall designate anaccountant, with terms of reference satisfactory to the Bank, to be responsible for the financial management

ZEP-RE grant agreement and project agreement: Within three months from the Effective Date, the Recipient shall have in place staffin each of the Participating Countries to liaise with the respective Project implementing agencies of the Participating Countriesand to provide regular reporting to them

title.narrative: People benefiting from greater gender equality

comment.narrative: Number of Female pastoralist registered

title.narrative: Djibouti - value of livestock and livestock product trade

comment.narrative: Djibouti has exceeded the target of USD25 million. This achievement partially explained by the fact that the base line value established during project preparation was affected by the COVID pandemic.

title.narrative: Djibouti - value of livestock and livestock product trade

comment.narrative: Djibouti has exceeded the target of USD25 million. This achievement partially explained by the fact that the base line value established during project preparation was affected by the COVID pandemic.

title.narrative: Increase in the savings contributions of pastoralists supported by the project

comment.narrative: This indicator aims to verify how the project has incentivized the growth of savings from the pastoralist groups supported by the project

title.narrative: Amount of investments supported under component 2 that limit GHG emissions or support adaptation of pastoralists

comment.narrative: climate adaptation or mitigation co-benefits will be an eligibility criteria for all investments under the facility to de-risk private investment in the livestock value chains

title.narrative: Number of testing for livestock products conducted by Somalia in line with international practice

comment.narrative: This includes the number of testing processes undertaken by the Somalia Ministry of Livestock, Forestry and Range, Somalia Bureau of Standards, Somaliland Quality Control Commission, and entities with a mandate to check the quality of livestock and livestock products, to ensure compliance with international norms

title.narrative: Percentage of pastoralists in target areas who received the information to understand the financial products

comment.narrative: This indicator aims to verify through surveys if pastoralist households have received capacity building to understand the financial products provided,

title.narrative: Percentage of pastoralists who report that financial services supported under the project have reduced livestock mortality and distressed sales.

comment.narrative: This reflect the impact of the product in reducing livestock mortality after a drought. This will be collected after a severe drought happens.

title.narrative: No. of NQI professionals trained on quality infrastructure using cross-border collaboration (total)

comment.narrative: This reflects the harmonization of standards by providing capacity building to quality infrastructure professionals using cross-border capacity building tools

title.narrative: No. of NQI professionals trained on quality infrastructure using cross-border collaboration (in Djibouti)

comment.narrative: This reflects the number of professionals trained on standards (quality infrastructure) in Djibouti

title.narrative: No. of NQI professionals trained on quality infrastructure using cross-border collaboration (In Ethiopia)

comment.narrative: This reflects the number of professionals trained on standards (quality infrastructure) in Ethiopia

title.narrative: Kenya - Value of Livestock and Livestock products traded by pastoralists as a result of the project

comment.narrative: This will reflect the value of livestock and livestock products traded by pastoralist groups linked to value chains. This assumes that the project would contribute 2.5% of the total value of Kenyan livestock exports (according to the Integrated National Export Development and Promotion Strategy, the potential export value of live animals would be USD$1.8 b and meat at USD$2.8 b at the end of the strategy period).

title.narrative: Kenya - Value of Livestock and Livestock products traded by pastoralists as a result of the project

comment.narrative: This will reflect the value of livestock and livestock products traded by pastoralist groups linked to value chains. This assumes that the project would contribute 2.5% of the total value of Kenyan livestock exports (according to the Integrated National Export Development and Promotion Strategy, the potential export value of live animals would be USD$1.8 b and meat at USD$2.8 b at the end of the strategy period).

title.narrative: Number of pastoralist groups supported by the project and connected to markets

comment.narrative: Those will be groups supported under Component 1 with the package of financial services, and that will be connected to reliable markets either through the same Component 1 or through the facility to de-risk private investment under Component 2. This will be assessed through contracts and off-take agreements but also through regular sales of livestock from the groups to livestock processors and exporters.

This will be assessed through contracts and off-take agreements but also through regular sales of livestock from the groups to livestock processors and exporters.

title.narrative: No. of NQI professionals trained on quality infrastructure using cross-border collaboration (in Somalia)

comment.narrative: This reflects the number of professionals trained on standards (quality infrastructure) in Somalia - includes the Somaliland Quality Control Commission staff

title.narrative: Amount of Private Capital Enabled or Mobilized through the project

comment.narrative: This reflects Private Capital Enabled (through Component 1) and Private Capital Mobilized (through Component 2)

title.narrative: Number of pastoralists and their dependents covered by financial services and capacity building under the project

comment.narrative: This reflects 250,000 pastoralists who are covered in year 5 by the package (savings, insurance, digital accounts), multiplied by the number of people in their households (average of 6.4). 50,000 pastoralists would be covered in year one, and this would increase by 50,000 per year.

comment.narrative: This reflects 250,000 pastoralists who are covered in year 5 by the package (savings, insurance, digital accounts), multiplied by the number of people in their households (average of 6.4). 50,000 pastoralists would be covered in year one, and this would increase by 50,000 per year.

title.narrative: Number of formal financial sector companies providing services to pastoralists under the project

comment.narrative: this will reflect the mobilization of microfinance institutions and banks around the provision of package of financial services, and in particular the opening of new savings accounts for pastoralists groups at those institutions

title.narrative: Number of trade facilitation measures supported by the project

comment.narrative: This reflects the number of interventions that facilitate livestock trade adopted in one location

title.narrative: Number of digital accounts in use during and at the end of the project

comment.narrative: This reflect the number of digital accounts that are in use as a result of the project, which could either be payment accounts, or savings accounts

title.narrative: Percentage of pastoralists who received payouts within 30 days of official announcements of payout by calculation agent

comment.narrative: This indicator will measure the speed at which pastoralists are paid insurance payouts, once the insurance has been triggered following a severe drought
